IncludeAndroid.description: Add an Android head project (needs the 'android' workload).

IncludeiOS.description: Add an iOS head project (needs a Mac with the 'ios' workload).

IncludeWasm.description: Add a browser / WebAssembly head project (needs the 'wasm-tools' workload).

msformsVersion.description: The Majorsilence.Forms NuGet package version to reference. This LAGS the repo version in Directory.Build.props on purpose: the template scaffolds a project that restores from nuget.org, so it can only name a version already PUBLISHED there. Bump it after a release goes out, never in the same change that sets the new version -- doing that fails CI's `template` job with NU1102.

avaloniaVersion.description: The Avalonia platform-package version the mobile/web heads reference.
